item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of prompts that ask you to check your own thinking: whether this moment supports the life you want, and whether you're projecting or mind reading. Those are the right questions. Today, notice one moment where you assume what someone else is thinking. Name it as a guess, not a fact. Then choose a response that fits the life you're building. Do that once before midday.
